what: Many test runs ran at once and pushed the machine load past what it could carry.
why: Every session ran validation on its own with no shared limit.
rule: Validation waits in the machine-wide queue.

what: Test runs kept going after the session that started them had died.
why: Nothing tied a running test to its parent session.
rule: A queue slot is reaped when its holder exits.

what: A session would not act on a relayed approval from another session.
why: Nothing recorded the approver's own words, so the relay could not be checked.
rule: A relay record holds the approver's exact words, and production deploys, payments, credentials and the owner's rules files still need the owner's own message in the session that does them.

what: Two sessions built the same story.
why: Nothing marked a story as taken before it was built.
rule: A story is claimed before it is built, and dispatch refuses a claimed story.

what: A change landed without full validation.
why: The push happened before the repo's validation had passed.
rule: A push happens only after the repo's validation passes.

what: An install was made that the user's own rules forbid.
why: The install was judged on its own merit and the user's rule that forbids it was not checked first.
rule: An install the user's rules forbid is not made.
